➢ Built-in 5Hz (5Hz~150Hz) or 10Hz (10Hz~240Hz) high
sensitivity geophone;
➢ Optional KCK version for external geophone string;
➢ 24-bit Δ-Σ ADC converter for high resolution, high dynamic
range seismic signal recording;
➢ Configurable sample rate and preamplifier gain;
➢ High sensitive GNSS module equipped with active patch
antenna supports GPS, Beidou, and GLONASS;
➢ Intermittent GNSS clock synchronization strategy, with timing
accuracy less than ± 10us；
➢ Internal lithium-ion battery pack supports seismic recording
for up to 800 hours;
➢ Built-in test signal generator supports on-site full signal chain
function and performance self-inspection and diagnosis,
including system noise, real-time dynamic range, geophone
impedance, natural frequency, sensitivity, damping, distortion,
etc.;
➢ BLE module together with visual LEDs for onsite configuration
and proximity. Ground communication distance around 20
meters , air communication distance over 100 meters,
supports vehicle or UAV patrol；
➢ P&R (Place & Record) mode for rapid and convenient infield
deployment, supporting automatic GNSS position matching
with line and point number;
➢ Industrial Android tablet supports working status verification
after deployment, including battery autonomy, environmental
temperature, tilting, ambient noise, real-time seismic
waveform, etc.;
➢ High strength engineering plastic enclosure for enhanced
anti-dropping capability, waterproof (IP68), flame retardant
(5VA), ultraviolet aging (F1)；
➢ Compact volume (9.8L x 10.8W x 11H cm) and light weight
(750g) for convenient transportation and deployment.
